list.title: Reseller Club
list.label: Manages domains on ResellerClub via API. ResellerClub requires your server IP in order to work. Login to the ResellerClub control panel (the url will be in the email you received when you signed up with them) and then go to Settings > API and enter the IP address of the server where FOSSBilling is installed to authorize it for API access.

userid.label: Reseller ID. You can get this at ResellerClub control panel Settings > Personal information > Primary profile > Reseller ID

api-key.label: ResellerClub API Key
api-key.description: You can get this at ResellerClub control panel, go to Settings -> API
